secret: Sneak while wearing it: a quiet greeting in the mob's own voice.

lore: {name}: he was never removed.
use: No mob drops it. Gold carries moss, moss carries netherrack, four red lights keep watch - light it at night. Place it, wear it or put it on a note block.
secret: Torches near its wearer flicker; in the dark, hostile mobs hesitate before they attack.

lore: {name}: Technoblade never dies.
use: No mob drops it. A pig with a certain name never dies - strike it down, and its crown falls instead; the title screen remembers him. Place it, wear it or put it on a note block.
secret: Pigs nearby turn their heads to its wearer, and the crown glints.

lore: {name}: the biggest trouble a full moon ever brought.
use: No ordinary zombie drops it. When lightning strikes a zombie under a full moon, something big gets up - only a charged creeper brings its head down. Place it, wear it or put it on a note block.
secret: Its wearer grows to 1.5x size, steps up whole blocks and walks a little faster; zombies see it only half as far, and it works like the head of its zombie kind (husk, drowned).

lore: {name}: it really did eat all that hay.
use: No ordinary cow drops it. A cow fed hay bales, one by one, may - very rarely - grow into a giant; only a charged creeper brings its head down. Place it, wear it or put it on a note block.
secret: Its wearer grows to 1.5x size and steps up whole blocks; another player can milk it like a cow.

lore: A book about every mob's head.
use: The Simple Mobheads Guide explains drops, variants and head abilities. Craft it shapeless from a book and a skeleton skull.
secret: Its pages follow the wiki, so it never tells more than the heads really do.
